items.title: Commencement
notes:
A meeting of City Council was held at 2:58 p.m. this date, chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

The meeting began with a Land Acknowledgement given by the Mayor.

To confirm all actions and proceedings of the Council for March 6, 2023.
Adjournment
notes: On motion the meeting adjourned at 3:01 p.m.
